Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Rajesh Khan. I am a 45-year-old professor living in Chennai. Nikhil Bansal gave me a cheque for ₹12,70,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 91358 55899 or email rajesh.khan@example.com.
